---
title: "Mermaid fig-align in revealjs"
format: revealjs
# bd-2pmjmjmj: the same wrapper and <pre> classes reach a deck (crossref
# rendering builds the float DOM for every HTML-family format), and the
# reveal stylesheet carries the matching SVG alignment rules.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["section div#fig-left.quarto-figure-left pre.mermaid", "section pre.mermaid.quarto-figure-right"]
        - []
---

## Float

```mermaid
%%| label: fig-left
%%| fig-cap: Aligned left.
%%| fig-align: left
flowchart LR
  a --> b
```

## Bare

```mermaid
%%| fig-align: right
flowchart LR
  c --> d
```
